name: Eedi Question-Anchored Tutoring Dialogues (QATD-2k)
summary: 1,971 real chat conversations between Eedi's math tutors and students aged about 11 to 13, each starting from the diagnostic question the student asked for help with, anonymized with PIIvot.
grades: not stated (students aged 11 to 13 on average, mostly in the UK)

license.note: The card's metadata says CC BY-NC 4.0 and its text CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. For commercial use, its card says to contact Eedi.
license.terms: non-commercial research only; never try to identify or re-identify anyone in it

cite: Zent, M., Smith, D., & Woodhead, S. (2025). PIIvot: A Lightweight NLP Anonymization Framework for Question-Anchored Tutoring Dialogues. EMNLP 2025. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.1397

fits.how: Real learners' turns, each anchored to a diagnostic question whose wrong answers are known: test cases that end on a learner's turn, and patterns for a simulated learner, which agent tests don't use yet.

connect.note: No connector is written yet. A test suite could end each case on a learner's turn. These are children's real words, so it would ask each person to accept its terms, and send them only to a model whose provider's terms allow it.
